title: Kolpona: An Agentic Framework with Gradient-Free Neuron Programming for RTL Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33973v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) for register-transfer level (RTL) design are usually improved by fine-tuning on curated Verilog corpora, which needs large sets of verified designs and GPU training. We present Kolpona, an agentic framework that improves such models without gradient training. Its first component is neuron programming, a new form of weight-space programming (WSP) that writes single neurons in closed form into the weights to remove failure habits found on practice tasks, and keeps each edit only when testbench results on fresh tasks favour it. At inference time, tool-using agents propose designs, and a label-free selection stage delivers one design per task from the specification, the candidates and their simulations alone. On Qwen3.5-4B, edits to 16 neurons raise the VerilogEval v2 pass@1 of the model alone from 31.7% to 55.4%, and the full framework reaches 77.6%. On Qwen3.8-27B, Kolpona lifts pass@1 from 73.1%

translated_title: Kolpona：一个用于RTL生成的无梯度神经元编程智能体框架
translated_abstract: 面向寄存器传输级（RTL）设计的开放权重大型语言模型（LLM）通常通过在精选的Verilog语料库上进行微调来改进，但这需要大量经过验证的设计数据集和GPU训练。我们提出了Kolpona，一个无需梯度训练即可改进此类模型的智能体框架。其第一个组件是神经元编程，这是一种新的权重空间编程（WSP）形式，以闭式方式将单个神经元写入模型权重中，以消除模型在实践任务中发现的失败习惯，并且仅当新任务上的测试平台结果支持该编辑时才予以保留。在推理阶段，使用工具的智能体提出设计方案，并由一个无标签的选择阶段仅依据规范、候选设计及其仿真结果为每个任务交付一个设计。在Qwen3.5-4B上，对16个神经元的编辑使模型本身的VerilogEval v2 pass@1从31.7%提升至55.4%，而完整框架达到了77.6%。在Qwen3.8-27B上，Kolpona将pass@1从73.1%进一步提升。
tldr: Kolpona是一个无需梯度训练的智能体框架，通过神经元编程（以闭式方式直接改写模型权重中的单个神经元）并仅在新任务测试结果有利时保留编辑，结合基于规范与仿真的无标签设计选择，显著提升开放权重LLM的Verilog生成性能，在Qwen3.5-4B上将VerilogEval v2 pass@1从31.7%提升至77.6%。
en_tdlr: Kolpona is a gradient-free agentic framework that improves open-weight LLMs for RTL generation through neuron programming—directly writing single neurons into weights and keeping edits only when testbench results on fresh tasks favor them—combined with label-free design selection, raising VerilogEval v2 pass@1 from 31.7% to 77.6% on Qwen3.5-4B.
